title: Analysis code for "Evolution of Non-Metallic Inclusions During the Industrial Secondary Refining of an Al-Killed, Ca-Treated, Low-S Steel"
description: Code for the typification, statistical evaluation, and visualisation of non-metallic inclusion data from the industrial secondary refining of an Al-killed, Ca-treated, low-S linepipe steel. Includes ternary kernel density estimation of inclusion compositions, non-parametric size comparisons with effect sizes and multiple-comparison correction, and the figure code for the associated publication.
